what: CDP screencast login bridge (replaces Xvfb/x11vnc/noVNC stack when root is missing)
how: 1. chromium headless=new with target profile + --remote-debugging-port=PORT (windowed chromium NOT needed)
2. python3 bridge_server.py  (CDP Page.startScreencast -> jpeg frames; Input.dispatchMouse/Key/insertText relay; HTTP on 6080)
4. give user <tunnel>/ - they click+type directly on the page
5. teardown: pkill cloudflared + bridge_server.py; URL is ephemeral, never reuse
viewer: Escritorio remoto: haz clic donde quieras y escribe directamente. Botón central arriba para Enter/Borrar.
